method: Same saved state and common closeRun; actual APIs, costs and RNG. Fixed policies chosen before results. Farm starts at1031 with the normal place repeat flag; nextRepeat chooses the next cell and departRun receives the actual previous run handle. After a farming defeat retreat one place. Retry boss after each ten farm attempts. Farming branches auto-equip and allocate newly earned points; they conserve potions while farming, replenish at most five minor potions before boss attempts with a500-gold reserve. No added resources, ranks, levels, counters or forced outcome.
